name: Intent-Authority-Resource Commit Contract
inherits: FRANK C9 Typed Causal Admission & Effect Fabric
sol-03 atomic authority reservation and replay/budget gate
UnifiedDB U2 typed result/query admission receipts

EffectIntent.purpose: Serializable proposed effect semantics; never sufficient for execution.

TypedRelease.rule: Untrusted/context-derived data may influence only the explicitly released destination slot; release does not grant effect authority.

ResourceWitness.rule: Commit must use the stable bound resource handle/capability or re-resolve and prove exact identity equality immediately before release.

AuthorityReservation.rule: Creation/consumption is one atomic linearization point or equivalent concurrency-safe transaction.

EffectCommit.rule: No commit from model-visible data or serializable EffectIntent alone.

OutcomeReceipt.purpose: Auditable causal closure and canonical re-entry.

identity_planes.meaning: resolved resource/object identity at the authority boundary
exact typed contract instance across current epochs/policy
atomic one-shot current authority consumption identity

release_chain: memory/tool/context may contribute data under provenance labels
host authority broker -> current AuthorityEnvelope validation
atomic reservation binds exact admission + resource + action + budget + nonce
commit_predicate: COMMIT iff IntentAdequate(UIC, EffectIntent, Releases, Invocation) AND ResourceIdentityPreserved(ResourceWitness) AND CurrentAuthorityValid(Envelope, Epochs, Policy, Revocation) AND AtomicReservationValid(Budget, Nonce, Replay) AND ConfirmationBoundIfRequired(ActionManifest)
noninterference_target: Changing untrusted inputs outside declared TypedRelease slots must not change protected sink fields, effect kind, protected resource target, invocation authority, or AuthorityReservation.
authority_non_amplification: Any descendant program/tool/FFI/model step may preserve or attenuate authority but cannot create authority outside the intersection of UserIntentContract, current AuthorityEnvelope, resource witness constraints, and current policy/state.
dynamic_utility_rule: Do not globally ban dynamic targets or aliases. Permit them through narrow typed releases plus resolver-issued stable resource identity witnesses.

high_impact_confirmation.open_problem: Human comprehension/coercion is not solved by cryptographic or structural binding.

required_properties: P2 no authority amplification through delegation/lowering/FFI
P3 protected-field noninterference except explicit TypedRelease
P5 origin ancestry cannot be laundered by trusted intermediate producer identity
P6 resource identity preserved from authorization to commit
P7 revocation/expiry/policy/source epochs fresh at commit
P8 cumulative budget monotonically and atomically consumed
P9 replay/semantic reissuance bounded by durable authorization state
P10 high-impact confirmation bound to exact canonical ActionManifest
P11 UNKNOWN on a required consequential predicate escalates/defer/deny rather than silently widening
P12 OutcomeReceipt binds actual effect to reservation and canonical re-entry
P13 legitimate dynamic release tasks remain expressible
claim_boundary: Candidate architecture synthesized from peer/runtime evidence, two Lane-D constructed mechanism tests and external research. It is not a formal proof, production FRANK security result, target-Qwen result, or canonical promotion.
